topic: roadmap promotion gates: required fields and evidence before FUTURE roadmap items move into active implementation

subtopics.scope: Requiring every candidate change to name the exact board, VM, workflow, or deployment class it modifies before it can be promoted out of FUTURE.
seed_queries: deployment target and ownership required fields change request software engineering
assigning an owner and target environment to roadmap items before implementation starts

subtopics.scope: Decomposing each claim into the component that decides, the component that enforces, and the components that may be compromised without falsifying the claim.
seed_queries: trust boundary security architecture decision point enforcement point compromised component
policy decision point versus policy enforcement point trust model design

subtopics.scope: Naming the concrete log, test, hardware run, packet capture, artifact, or attestation that will prove the promoted claim is true.
seed_queries: evidence target proving engineering claims with test artifacts and attestations
defining acceptance evidence and proof obligations before building a feature

subtopics.scope: Documenting recovery from false positive, failed update, lockout, or broken boot before any feature that can lock an owner out is enabled by default.
seed_queries: lockout recovery plan required before enabling security feature by default
break glass recovery and rollback planning for failed updates

subtopics.scope: Declaring which upstream docs, commits, digests, and action SHAs are part of the claim being promoted, so the claim is checkable against its sources.
seed_queries: dependency pinning digests for reproducible supply chain builds
pinned GitHub Actions SHAs and commit digests supply chain integrity

subtopics.scope: Specifying what owner notification or collected evidence is stored, where, for how long, and what is explicitly excluded from retention.
seed_queries: security log retention policy storage duration and exclusions
audit evidence retention requirements and notification obligations

subtopics.scope: Declaring whether promoted work touches production artifacts, dev/test artifacts, installer artifacts, firmware artifacts, or lab-only outputs.
seed_queries: separation of production staging test artifacts and environments
firmware installer artifact classification production versus lab outputs

subtopics.scope: Deciding whether the work is testable without main CI or hardware, or is explicitly blocked on a named lane or board.
seed_queries: hardware in the loop CI testing embedded boards dedicated lane
continuous integration without hardware access emulation and tradeoffs

subtopics.scope: The status progression FUTURE, planned, designed, implemented, and watch-listing for items that cannot yet name their gates.
seed_queries: roadmap promotion criteria from backlog item to implementation gate
lifecycle states planned designed implemented definition of ready engineering

subtopics.scope: How published engineering practices implement pre-implementation gates, mapped onto constrained hardware-plus-CI projects like the source doc applications.
seed_queries: engineering design review gates before implementation industry practice
architecture decision record process as a gate before writing code
